title: Export: download, a new GitHub repository, or a pull request
description: Imported by OWN-0 from runtime/executive/mission-imports/2026-10-23-customer-ownership.json. Source ticket: OWN-EXPORT.
objective: Whoever manages a project can take it out of KoreLumina with everything KoreLumina changed: as a download, as a new private GitHub repository, or as a pull request on the repository it was imported from.
risks: The customer's GitHub connection is used only for actions they start, through the Connected accounts store; a pasted token is used once and never kept.
A push must never target the default branch and never force-push.
The first live push to GitHub happens only on the owner's own test account, with the owner's approval.

tasks.title: Download the project as a zip
acceptanceCriteria: The zip holds the project as it is now in KoreLumina
node_modules, build output, .git and every .env file are left out
Available on every plan to whoever manages the project, enforced in Runtime

tasks.title: Export to a new private GitHub repository
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime creates a private repository under the token's account or a chosen organisation and pushes the project as one commit
The token is used once and never stored, logged or returned
Pro and above, enforced in Runtime

tasks.title: Open a pull request on the original repository
acceptanceCriteria: For projects imported from GitHub, the changes since import are pushed to a korelumina/ branch and a pull request is opened
Never pushes to the default branch, never force-pushes
The customer sees exactly which files change before approving

tasks.title: Export window in the Knowledge Operations design
acceptanceCriteria: Shows real progress and the resulting repository or pull request link
The owner approves it visually and its UI contract is certified
